scientific_integrity: A complete mathematical proof uses standard origin-automorphism classification and torsion; symbolic verification checks universal defining identities and a finite permutation group only. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Geometric automorphisms of the smooth affine open curve only; not the automorphism group scheme or the complete projective elliptic automorphism group. Prior work already gives the visible subgroup and invariant field; classification of the full affine group and upgrade to the full-group affine quotient are the new content. Historical priority still subject to independent scrutiny.
title: No extra affine automorphisms at CM parameters for the four-punctured elliptic \(C_d\) family
